title: ASUSTOR advisory AS-2026-029: six high-rated ADM flaws including OpenVPN profile command execution (CVE-2026-134896)
date_note: Advisory page gives 2026-11-24 with initial public release 2026-11-23.
summary: ASUSTOR's advisory AS-2026-029 lists six CVEs in ADM, each rated High under CVSS 4.0, which let an authenticated user run commands with elevated privileges or create and truncate system files. One, CVE-2026-134896, is command execution through a crafted OpenVPN .ovpn profile. Affected are ADM 4.1.0 through 4.3.3.RY62 and 5.0.0 through 5.1.4.RM62; the advisory lists fixes in ADM 5.1.5.RNN1 and 4.3.4.Rxxx.
plain: ASUSTOR says six flaws in its NAS operating system ADM let a logged-in user run commands or alter system files. Its advisory lists fixed versions.
exec: ASUSTOR's advisory says the ADM flaws could fully compromise confidentiality, integrity and availability of an affected device.
action: ASUSTOR advises upgrading to ADM 5.1.5.RNN1 or above (ADM 5.0) or ADM 4.3.4.Rxxx or above (ADM 4.3, 4.2 and 4.1); it lists no workarounds.

sources.name: ASUSTOR Product Security Advisory AS-2026-029: ADM

validation.note: ASUSTOR's own advisory AS-2026-029 (primary) lists all six CVEs; CVE Feed repeats the CVE-2026-134896 row only. VulDB returned 403.
